children: fell 3.32% premarket after the company named Anil Chakravarthy president and chief executive effective December 1. Chakravarthy currently runs Adobe's Customer Experience Orchestration business and worldwide field operations, and will join the board. Shantanu Narayen, who said in March he would step down after 18 years leading the company, becomes executive chair.

Chakravarthy joined Adobe in January 2020 to lead Digital Experience, picked up worldwide field operations later that year, and was promoted to president of both in December 2021. On his watch the company shipped CX Enterprise, GenStudio and Brand Visibility, scaled Adobe Experience Platform, and bought Workfront and Semrush.

The same day, David Wadhwani said he is leaving. He has run Adobe's creativity and productivity business for nearly five years and was widely seen as a strong candidate for the job, partly for his role in the abandoned Figma bid.
Adobe reports fiscal third-quarter results on September 10, a week after announcing the transition, which puts Chakravarthy's first public test alongside numbers Narayen is still responsible for.

title: Adobe Names Chakravarthy CEO as Wadhwani Heads for the Exit
